purpose: Connect the already-merged exact-Version MonitoringContext evidence foundation to the normal Song engineering experience so listening-environment evidence is visible and reviewable where engineering judgments are made, with exact one-shot USER_DECLARED writes for the current Version only.

lineage.outcome: The artist can see the listening environment and monitoring path that contextualize engineering evidence for the exact current Song Version, and can explicitly record an exact-Version declaration without fabricating measurement or calibration truth.
lineage.capability: Consumer-reachable MonitoringContext attached to Song engineering evidence

why_now: Canonical SCOPE_LEDGER still marks REQ-SCOPE-057 as a Gate-B blocker and RECONCILE / IMPLEMENT item. PR #107 already merged the exact Song/Version MonitoringContext semantic foundation, while the normal Song engineering journey already exposes signal, mix-relationship and performance-timing evidence. The missing gap is consumer composition, not another evidence store or analysis engine. Live ownership search found no current MonitoringContext claim and this bounded seam avoids active memory.py, capability, release, songwriting, compare and provider/DAW worklines.
instead_of_what: Do not build hardware discovery, calibration certification, hearing-safety logic, another evidence database, a second engineering surface, broader-scope browser mutation, provider verification, DAW control or automatic processing. Reuse MonitoringContextService, canonical EvidenceMemory and the existing Song engineering installer.

implementation_contract.read_truth: The Song page resolves the current Version through the existing MonitoringContextService and preserves UNKNOWN, PARTIAL, CONFLICT and RESOLVED as distinct states. Existing source kinds remain visible by human-readable provenance class without exposing claim IDs, source references, profile IDs, Song IDs, Version IDs or fingerprints.
implementation_contract.write_truth: The browser can write only USER_DECLARED evidence for one exact default monitoring fact on the exact current Version. Every submit button carries a one-shot server-side action binding to exact Song, Version, monitoring key and prior MonitoringContext fingerprint.
implementation_contract.revision_truth: A new browser declaration may supersede only active USER_DECLARED evidence at the exact same Version/key. It cannot supersede OBSERVED, MEASURED or PROVIDER_VERIFIED evidence; disagreement remains CONFLICT.
implementation_contract.freshness_truth: Active Song, current Version and prior MonitoringContext fingerprint are revalidated after action consumption and before the evidence write. Foreign Host/Origin, invalid CSRF, stale context and replay fail closed.
implementation_contract.authority_truth: Monitoring context is EVIDENCE_ONLY. Recording or displaying it does not mutate audio, create a Version, approve a Version, certify a room or hearing safety, call a provider or DAW, publish, purchase, spend, or grant external-action authority.

completion_proof: normal /song consumer rendering includes one Listening Context card whenever an exact current Version exists
GET is read-only and creates no monitoring Evidence claim
UNKNOWN / PARTIAL / CONFLICT / RESOLVED remain distinct and existing broader-scope evidence can be read without being rewritten
consumer HTML hides profile, Artist, Song, Version, Evidence claim, source-reference and context-fingerprint identifiers
the browser exposes no OBSERVED, MEASURED or PROVIDER_VERIFIED write selector
one exact monitoring-fact action records USER_DECLARED technical evidence on the exact current Version
a later exact-Version browser declaration supersedes only the prior active USER_DECLARED claim for that key
existing MEASURED evidence remains active when the artist declares a different value and the resulting context stays CONFLICT
foreign Origin/Host rejection occurs before action consumption, replay cannot duplicate evidence, and stale context fingerprints fail closed
relaunch reconstructs the current listening context from canonical EvidenceMemory without another persistence owner
full regression and staged consumer smoke pass at the exact candidate head on Ubuntu, macOS and Windows

evidence_snapshot.execution_note: Authored implementation and focused adversarial tests are not completion proof. Merge requires fresh exact-head Ubuntu, macOS and Windows governance, context lifecycle, supervision, full regression, staged consumer smoke, evidence upload and exact-head success publication.

non_scope: automatic room correction, gain staging or processing
browser creation of OBSERVED, MEASURED or PROVIDER_VERIFIED evidence
browser writes at Song, Artist or Profile scope
closing all AUDIO-01 or every aspect of REQ-SCOPE-057
